testing.name: X3: fade the team missing 2+ FRESH rotation players
testing.backtest: 142-108 (56.8%) over two seasons vs the close; 147-103 at the open

testing.how: Like X2, and the missing players are all at different positions (guard / wing / big).
testing.name: X4: fade the team missing 2+ rotation players at different positions
testing.backtest: 139-103 (57.4%) over two seasons vs the close; 142-101 at the open

testing.how: The market expects a letdown after a blowout win; bet the team that won big.
testing.name: X5: back the team that won its last game by 25+
testing.backtest: 169-134 (55.8%) at the open, 159-122 (56.6%) at the close, both seasons

testing.how: Its last game went to overtime: bet the opponent at the first line we see.
testing.name: X6: fade the team coming off overtime (first line only)
testing.backtest: 117-90 (56.5%) at the open; only 105-95 at the close

testing.how: Both teams' field-goal points ran 2+ a game below what their shots were worth (last 5).
testing.name: X7: both teams shooting below their shot quality -> over
testing.backtest: 121-102 (54.3%) at the open, 114-98 (53.8%) at the close

testing.how: The spread moved 2+ points from the first line we saw: bet the side it moved toward, after the move.
testing.name: X8: follow a 2+ point line move
testing.backtest: 279-223 (55.6%) at the closing number, both seasons

testing.name: X9: home team with 2+ more days of rest

testing.how: Injury news leaves our worst-case read 3+ points off the market: paper bet at that moment's line.
testing.name: Injury desk: beat the market to the news
testing.backtest: new: no history before Nov 10

testing.how: A player who averaged 28+ minutes comes back after missing 3+ straight games: under on his points / rebounds / assists when the line sits 3+ (1.5 on rebounds/assists) above our number.
testing.name: Props: Star back from 3+ games out (minutes usually limited): unders
testing.backtest: minutes study: game 1 back -5.1 min, -2.6 pts, 63% below their usual (289 returns, both seasons agree); no prop-line history

testing.how: The teammates who played 5+ more minutes while he was out, the night he comes back: under when the line still reflects their bigger role.
testing.name: Props: Fill-ins the night the star returns (they lose about half the extra minutes): unders
testing.backtest: minutes study: fill-ins went 17.2 usual / 26.2 while he was out / 21.4 the night he returned (627); no prop-line history

testing.how: In this season's games a rotation player missed, a teammate played 5+ more minutes, but the players model doesn't give him the bump tonight (so the market may not either): over.
testing.name: Props: Hidden bump (history says +5 min, the players model doesn't see it): overs
testing.backtest: minutes study: real +5.5 min, +2.7 pts (388 cases, 2 seasons); no prop-line history, so CLV decides

testing.how: A rotation player is freshly ruled out and, in this season's games he missed, a teammate really played 5+ more minutes: over on that teammate's points / rebounds / assists when the line is short of what he did then.
testing.name: Props: Minutes jump (this season's games without him): overs
testing.backtest: minutes study: bench guys with a history bump got +8.4 min, +3.9 pts (603 cases); no prop-line history

testing.how: The players model (and likely the market) expects a teammate to get 5+ more minutes, but in 3+ games this season without that player he gained under 2: under when the line sits above what he did then.
testing.name: Props: Fake bump (everyone expects minutes, history says no): unders
testing.backtest: minutes study: +0.8 min but still +2.5 pts (244 cases): a weak under; no prop-line history

testing.how: A rotation player is freshly ruled out, no games yet without him, and the players model gives a teammate 5+ more minutes: over when our projection beats the line.
testing.name: Props: Minutes jump (players model only): overs
testing.backtest: minutes study: the naive bump came in at +1.5 min, +2.8 pts (1,368 cases); no prop-line history

testing.how: The first time a game's props post (often the night before): our model 3+ points (1.5 reb / ast) off a venue's line, at that venue's price. Judged by the record and whether the line then moves our way.
testing.name: Props A: opening lines
testing.backtest: history: our model vs soft books 6 h before tip was about break-even (-1%); opening lines are earlier and softer, untested
testing.clv_unit: points of line movement our way

101.name: Double-OT hangover
101.rule: Opponent played 2OT+ last night (won or lost) → bet against them

102.name: 3rd game in 4 nights vs rested team
102.rule: Opponent on 3rd game in 4 nights, we have 2+ days rest → bet us

103.name: Back-to-back at altitude
103.rule: Opponent on a back-to-back at Denver or Utah → bet DEN/UTA

104.name: Cross-country back-to-back
104.rule: Opponent on a back-to-back after 1,500+ miles of travel → bet against them

105.name: Both teams tired: under
105.rule: Both teams on a back-to-back → bet the under

106.name: Bounce-back after blowout loss
106.rule: Team lost by 25+ last game → bet them

107.name: Fade the blowout winner
107.rule: Opponent won by 25+ last game and is favored → bet against them

108.name: Home favorite on a losing streak
108.rule: Home favorite on 3+ straight losses → bet them

109.name: Home dog vs a hot team
109.rule: Home underdog vs a team on 5+ straight wins → bet the home dog

110.name: Game 2 of a two-game set
110.rule: Same teams, same building, within 3 days → bet the game-1 loser

111.name: Heavy favorite over, no filters
111.rule: Favorite by 10+, total 225+ → bet the over (control test for System 4)

112.name: Big rested favorite vs tired dog
112.rule: Favorite by 8+ with rest vs dog on a back-to-back → bet the favorite

113.name: Players model
113.rule: The players model's line is 4+ pts off the market whether day-to-day players play or sit, the team isn't bottom-10, and no blind spots → bet that side

121.name: Late-season mismatch over
121.rule: Last 3 weeks of the season, favorite by 10+ → over. 6 seasons: 194-124 (61.0%), every season up

122.name: Late-season low total over
122.rule: Last 3 weeks, total in the lowest quarter of the season's totals → over. 149-91 (62.1%)

123.name: Post-All-Star mismatch, tired home team over
123.rule: After the All-Star break, favorite by 10+, home team on its 4th game in 6 nights → over. 149-86 (63.4%)

124.name: Fade the OT winner on 4 games in 6 nights
124.rule: Team won its last game in overtime and is on its 4th game in 6 nights → bet against. 69-31 (69.0%)

125.name: Fade the tanker, last 3 weeks
125.rule: Last 3 weeks of the season, opponent is .350 or worse after 40+ games (and we aren't) → bet us. 6 seasons: 212-164 (56.4%) vs the close

130.name: MONEYBALL: 2+ systems + players model agrees 3+
130.rule: Two or more of our systems on the same side AND the players model likes that side by 3+ points (either way day-to-day players go). 2 seasons at the open: 29-11 (72.5%), both seasons 72-73%. Sized to win $40 (2 units).

131.name: STACK: 6+ flags on one side (or 5 with the players model and a system)
131.rule: 6 or more separate edges on the same side (or 5 when two of them are the players model 3+ and a card system): players model 3+, card systems (1 / 2+), the injury fades (X2-X4), blowout winner (X5), opponent off overtime (X6), line moved 1+ / 2+ toward it, home rest edge, opponent leans on players the model barely knows, opponent shooting hot / us cold vs shot quality, opponent on a back-to-back. 2 seasons at the close: 6+ 118-73 (61.8%), 60.0% / 63.7%; 5+ with the players model and a system 46-26 (63.9%). Every flag is listed on the bet. Sized to win $40 (2 units).

132.name: SYS+X4: a system + fading a team missing 2+ players at different positions
132.rule: A card system fires on a side AND the other team is missing 2+ rotation players at different positions (1+ of them fresh). 2 seasons at the close: 42-18 (70.0%; 22-10 / 20-8). No players-model read needed. Sized to win $20.

133.name: X4+B2B: fade a team missing 2+ players at different positions, on a back-to-back
133.rule: X4 fires (the other team missing 2+ rotation players at different positions, 1+ fresh) AND that team is on a back-to-back and we aren't. 42-18 (70.0%; 23-9 / 19-9). $20.

134.name: X2+B2B: fade a team missing 2+ players, on a back-to-back
134.rule: X2 fires (the other team missing 2+ rotation players, 1+ fresh) AND that team is on a back-to-back and we aren't. 62-31 (66.7%; 33-16 / 29-15). $20.

135.name: MOVE+THIN: line moved 2+ our way against a team leaning on unknown players
135.rule: The spread moved 2+ points toward our side since the first line AND the other team gets 5+ points more of its minutes from players the model barely knows. 79-44 (64.2%; 36-17 / 43-27). Forms late (needs the move). $20.

136.name: RIM+PM: rim matchup + the players model 3+
136.rule: We take a top-30% share of our shots at the rim (last 10) AND they allow a top-30% share at the rim, AND the players model likes us by 3+. 36-14 (72.0%; 24-8 / 12-6). $20.

137.name: SQ+X3: better by the shots + X3
137.rule: Our shot-quality margin (what our shots were worth minus what we allowed, last 10) beats theirs by 6.8+ AND X3 fires (they're missing 2+ fresh rotation players). 29-12 (70.7%; 14-7 / 15-5). $20.

138.name: UNLUCKY+X4: unlucky by the shots + X4
138.rule: Our real margins ran 7.2+ a game below our shot-quality margins (last 10) AND X4 fires. 30-15 (66.7%; 18-9 / 12-6). $20.

139.name: SQ+THIN: better by the shots + they lean on unknown players
139.rule: Better by the shots (6.8+) AND the other team gets 5+ points more of its minutes from players the model barely knows. 66-37 (64.1%; 35-15 / 31-22). $20.

140.name: 3HOT+MOVE: they've hit 3s way above their value + the line moved our way
140.rule: Their made 3s ran 4.7+ points a game above what their 3s were worth (last 5) AND the spread moved 1+ toward us. 91-58 (61.1%; 39-24 / 52-34). Forms late. $20.

201.name: Season-opener over
201.rule: Both teams playing their first game of the season → bet the OVER. Flipped 2026-10-20: replayed on 2024-25 + 2025-26, opener unders went 6-22 vs the close (overs 22-6)

202.name: Early home underdog
202.rule: Home underdog of 7 or less in the first 2 weeks → bet the home dog

203.name: Fade early big favorite
203.rule: Favorite of 10+ in the first 2 weeks → bet the underdog

204.name: Early blowout bounce-back
204.rule: Lost by 15+ last game, first 3 weeks → bet them

205.name: Fade early blowout winner
205.rule: Won by 15+ last game and favored, first 3 weeks → bet against them

206.name: Back the winless team
206.rule: Team is 0-3 or worse, first 3 weeks → bet them

207.name: Fade the unbeaten favorite
207.rule: Team is 3-0 or better and favored, first 3 weeks → bet against them

208.name: Early-season over
208.rule: Every game in the first 2 weeks → over. Last 4 seasons 226-181 (55.5%) vs the close, +1.6 to +2.5 pts a game each year; 2020-21 and 2021-22 went the other way (scoring fell)

301.name: Personnel side, every game
301.rule: Whichever side the personnel line likes, every game, any gap. Graded so the record can be split by gap size, day-to-day status and blind spots.

302.name: Fade the team missing 2+ rotation players
302.rule: A team is missing 2+ rotation players (20+ mpg), more than its opponent, at least one of them played its last game → bet the opponent. 2 seasons vs the close: 249-199 (55.6%), both seasons 55-56% (engine/measure_cluster.py). Tracking only until it earns real money.

303.name: Fade the team missing 2+ FRESH rotation players
303.rule: Like X2, but at least 2 of the missing rotation players played the team's last game (fresh news; long absences are already priced). 2 seasons vs the close: 142-108 (56.8%; 58.1% / 55.6%), at the open 147-103 (engine/measure_cluster.py, Nov 11). Tracking only.

304.name: Fade the team missing 2+ rotation players at different positions
304.rule: Like X2 (1+ fresh), and the missing players are all at different positions (guard / wing / big): the team can't just slide the next man in. 2 seasons vs the close: 139-103 (57.4%; 59.5% / 55.0%), at the open 142-101 (engine/measure_cluster.py, Nov 11). Tracking only.

305.name: Back the team that won its last game by 25+
305.rule: The market expects a letdown after a blowout win; it doesn't come. 2 seasons: 169-134 at the open, 159-122 at the close, both seasons (engine/measure_ideas.py, Nov 11). Tracking only.

306.name: Fade the team coming off an overtime game (early line)
306.rule: Its last game went to overtime: bet the opponent at the FIRST line. 2 seasons: 117-90 at the open, only 105-95 at the close (engine/measure_ideas.py, Nov 11). Tracking only.

307.name: Both teams shooting below their shot quality: over
307.rule: Both teams' field-goal points ran 2+ a game below what their shots were worth (shot locations, last 5 games). 2 seasons: 121-102 at the open, 114-98 at the close (engine/measure_ideas.py). Tracking only.

308.name: Follow a 2+ point line move
308.rule: The spread moved 2+ points from the first line we saw: bet the side it moved toward, at the price after the move. 2 seasons at the close: 279-223 (55.6%), both seasons (engine/measure_ideas2.py). Tracking only.

309.name: Home team with 2+ more days of rest
309.rule: Home team rested 2+ more days than the visitor -> home. 2 seasons: 66-41 at the open, 63-43 at the close (engine/measure_ideas2.py). Tracking only.
